handoffs.message: Implemented read-only BFF OSS preactivation aggregate at GET /api/v1/operator/research/oss-preactivation with bounded activity_limit, dormant backend inventory for openclaw qlib trl finrl rllib ray_tune wandb, safe stub/handoff/manual dispatch metadata, cross-service activity rows, fail-closed rejection verification, and degraded behavior when service URLs are missing. Wired operator-bff compose envs to policy-learning, research-orchestrator, research-worker-gateway, and OpenClaw adapter without enabling activation. Updated BFF/API inventory, OSS checklist, and research maturity docs to distinguish pre-activation metadata from production activation. Verification: python3 -m pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_research_oss_preactivation_contract.py -q => 2 passed; python3 -m pytest services/research/tests/test_research_orchestrator_http_service.py services/policy-learning/tests/test_policy_learning_http_service.py services/research-worker-gateway/tests/test_research_worker_gateway_http_service.py services/research-worker-gateway/tests/test_research_worker_gateway_rejection_policy.py services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/test_main.py -q => 37 passed; docker compose config --quiet => passed; python3 scripts/smoke_dormant_oss_matrix.py => 7/7 acceptable, gate_state=closed 7/7, activated=false 7/7.
